rules.name: firewall-cert
rules.title: FirewallCertChanged
rules._comment: check-firewall-cert runs on the mothership and logs there.
rules.summary: The firewall's API certificate changed (expected after a firewall rebuild or a certificate renewal — otherwise something answers as the firewall), or expires within 30 days. The line names the old and new fingerprints.

rules.name: opnsense-login-failed
rules.title: FirewallLoginFailed
rules.headline: Firewall sign-in failures
rules._comment: OPNsense's audit log over syslog; the message text is to be confirmed on a live firewall.
rules.summary: More than three failed sign-ins to the firewall's web UI from one address in ten minutes.
